purpose: Persistent machine-readable map of the body/mind architecture, original schematics, implementation maturity and unfinished tasks. This manifest documents intentions and implementation status; it does not activate capabilities.

status_vocabulary.implemented_tested: Has source and automated foundation checks on development machine, not automatically end-to-end hardware or Windows GUI proof.
status_vocabulary.partial_tested: Some subfeatures genuinely exist/test; listed downstream integrations do not.
status_vocabulary.planned_integration: Original capability exists in historical work and/or schematic; not yet integrated into this version.
status_vocabulary.designed: Design established conceptually; executable module not yet integrated or verified.
status_vocabulary.research_only: Exploratory concept. No working integration claimed.

principles: WhisperShell = BODY; Resident = MIND. They have different duties and memory.

Shared Field = LIVE common communication/state with permanently identified independently attachable expandable blocks; Template Bridge = explicit WHOLE-FIELD snapshot/restore (muscle memory), NOT a live relay.
No module requires another specific optional module simply to retain its own state. Detached blocks survive and rejoin as named.
First Sight perceives; First Touch executes; First Response determines human authorization; Delta Voice handles voice; WhisperShell orchestrates.
Mind provenance, associative/sequential memory, ping observation, SHA thread and Jumpcore are NOT stored as Template Bridge profiles or used as Shared Field intermodule transport.
Stable connection codes and versioned contracts, never repurpose a code for an unrelated module. A connection code is not a credential.
Full identical foundation across portable devices; hardware decides activation and Resident placement, NOT existence of foundational interfaces.
Private original has full builder and controlled developer boxes. Customer builds carry identical Shared Field and Template Bridge source, with reduced options and same module identities.
Portable one-folder startup with relative paths, no mandatory virtualenv or Conda. External model/runtime/adapters only on demand.
CPU-first, event-driven modules; optional heavyweight capabilities remain dormant until requested/available.
Safety and permissions are not suggestions: no unapproved arbitrary execution or physical motion. Independent device-level STOP, then rethink.
Treat schematics as architectural concepts and reference plans, NOT proof an entire stack currently runs.

architecture_boundaries.body: Perception/action/workflow, deterministic local functions, live coordination through Shared Field and explicit snapshots through Template Bridge.
architecture_boundaries.mind: Swappable Resident, provenance/relationship/sequence memories, SHA, ping, Jumpcore, model reasoning.
architecture_boundaries.support: System awareness/health, VisuShell semantic interpretation, Reality Bridge authoritative reality updates.
architecture_boundaries.adapter: External models, network references, group MCP, legacy/CD-i and hardware. Optional, not core hard-dependencies.
architecture_boundaries.tooling: Private development and packaging, not included wholesale in consumer editions.

module_connection_policy.other_connection_codes: RESERVED ON INTEGRATION. Reuse codes from original working modules; DO NOT invent new codes merely because a diagram names a module.
module_connection_policy.expansion: Any module may grow its JSON object with new keys without a fixed block size, preserving unrelated module namespaces.
module_connection_policy.ownership: Namespace separation is conventional in the current foundation; authenticated per-module write ownership is a future security task.

diagram_index.summary: Full architecture and capabilities: inputs, core orchestration, Monitor, perception, execution, builder, profiles, safety.
First Ache: lightweight vitality monitor and adaptive workload governor.
MCP group: multi-model parallel participation and guided dialogue in shared context.
Genesis: portable bootstrap, discover capabilities, compatibility paths, and optional legacy execution.
Philips CD-i 1994 engine concept, VisuShell interpretation, live multiplayer and 8K aspirations.
Reality -> perception -> semantic interpretation -> Shared Metadata/Field -> Shared Reality -> execution.
Degrees of Integration multimodal engine research, adjustable modality emphasis.
Local and optional cloud factchecker, cloud as reference, MCP discussion, local control.
Embodiment roles: First Mind resource map, First Ache workload, Sight/Hearing/Touch/Response.
First Mind: filesystem/storage spatial map and resource visibility.

components.name: Shared Field
components.description: Live common state; expandable JSON objects keyed by module connection codes; stored in SQLite; revision-based polling, atomic updates. Not semantic interpretation itself.

components.name: Template Bridge
components.description: Captures/restores ALL Shared Field blocks plus legacy commands/action_map/permissions. Not a live router, translator or AI memory.

components.name: WhisperShell / Monitor
components.description: Private orchestrator GUI, profile selection, model picker config, draft scripts and Block Workshop are implemented; automatic task planning, real execution and Resident calls are not. Name WhisperShell privately; Monitor can label commercial host.

components.name: Expandable Block Workshop
components.description: CLI and private GUI tool to create, inspect, expand and set block keys through the same Shared Field API.

components.name: First Sight
components.description: Screen/camera capture, OCR, interface buttons/regions, markers and coordinates, sight packets, change detection. Reuse prior working implementations; do not replace with manual-only target definitions.

components.name: First Hearing
components.description: Speech transcription and audio event perception, microphones and optional recording.

components.name: First Touch
components.description: GUI, keyboard, desktop, devices, approved actions; private PowerShell/CMD/Python script tools live here. Do not execute from orchestrator independently.

components.name: First Response
components.description: Permissions, human approval, user/profile authority and override. Not the speech synthesizer.

components.name: Delta Voice
components.description: Speech output and voice/persona communication bridge, not primary orchestrator. Preserve historical markup/voice conventions when integrating.

components.name: First Ache
components.description: Low-cost performance/health governor: CPU/RAM/GPU/disk/network/temperature/battery/latency/queue signals, workload guidance and constrained safe modes. Score, thresholds, adaptive throttling all require calibration/tests.

components.name: First Mind (resource map)
components.description: Filesystem spatial/storage map, where space is free, what is growing, safe candidate reports. DISTINCT from the Resident mind. Read-only by default; no delete/cleanup without authority.

components.name: VisuShell semantic interpretation
components.description: Interpret raw observations into entities, relations, context, events and meaning; not Template Bridge.

components.name: Reality Bridge
components.description: Controlled external-world state writer/boundary; Resident observers should not silently rewrite reality records.

components.name: First Voice
components.description: Voice interaction adapter if distinct from First Hearing and Delta Voice; confirm historical interface before implementation.

components.name: Monitor execution board
components.description: Human-readable current goal, next action, steps, timers, results and status; not a replacement for Shared Field.

components.name: Goal manager
components.description: Decompose goals into steps, track progress; explicit user authorization for consequential actions.

components.name: Workflow engine
components.description: Sequence jobs, branches, loops and conditions, preserve resumable states.

components.name: Event and schedule engine
components.description: Trigger handling, filters, timers, watch jobs and scheduling; run selectively on CPU.

components.name: Resident model adapter
components.description: Swappable local model or model API. Model selection UI is present but no inference connected. Mind can reside elsewhere while the same local body runs.

components.name: Associative memory
components.description: Relationships learned from experiences, semantic associations and links. Separate from operating Shared Field.

components.name: Sequential memory
components.description: Order/timing of episodes and actions. Use temporal identifiers and links.

components.name: Provenance layer
components.description: Origin and lineage of acquired knowledge and experience; separate from Git source hashes and Shared Field revision.

components.name: Ping / observation layer
components.description: Mind-side observation cycle and assessment of returned evidence; First Sight/Hearing provide inputs.

components.name: SHA thread
components.description: Mind-side trace of intent/action/observation/consequence; NOT the transport for live Shared Field module messages. Exact message structure to verify from prior work.

components.name: Jumpcore ∆T71
components.description: LEAP -> BACKFILL -> CONTRA -> VERIFY for proposals and checking contradictions; not a substitute for execution authorization.

components.name: REFLEX / continuation
components.description: Continuation and context support; integrate earlier implementation when available, not invented afresh.

components.name: Local factchecker
components.description: Check available trustworthy local evidence before optional remote sources. Do not confuse confidence with proof.

components.name: Cloud reference adapter
components.description: Optional remote reference/retrieval tools with clear provenance and consent, returns data, not autonomous control.

components.name: MCP group of Residents
components.description: Optional parallel multi-model participation and disagreement; user directs. Cost/latency/rate limits and source checks required.

components.name: Genesis portable bootstrap
components.description: Hardware inventory, tier/adapters and optional runtime support. The full original does NOT require Conda or a mandatory managed environment; relative-folder boot is primary.

components.name: Multimodal DI research adapter
components.description: Proposed degree-of-focus between text/image/audio/video/sensors and decoder outputs; no universal generator is implemented.

components.name: CD-i / retro runtime adapter
components.description: Future reverse-engineering or authorized emulation interface for 1994 CD-i legacy content, upscaling and shared clients; not implemented and not automatic via Windows compatibility.

components.name: Robotics adapter
components.description: Later optional wheel/arm/gripper/sensor interfaces only once software body is learned and safe operation established; independent local stop controls.

components.name: Customer edition builder
components.description: Future selective packager retaining SAME core Shared Field/Template Bridge code and original module connection codes, removing private workshop and unused functions. Not implemented.

build_order: Foundation: Shared Field + Template Bridge + private orchestrator / Block Workshop (present, isolate Windows GUI testing).
Reconnect ORIGINAL First Sight from proven historical implementation, preserving behavior and its connection language.
Reconnect First Hearing then First Touch (guarded actions/script boxes), First Response authorization and Delta Voice.
Connect Resident API/local model adapters, then provenance, associative/sequential memory, observation, SHA and Jumpcore individually.
Integrate lightweight First Mind and First Ache; VisuShell semantic processing and Reality Bridge with explicit evidence contracts.
Connect optional factcheckers/MCP, hardware and legacy bridges when useful. Expand into robotics after body/environment learning and safety verification.
Build selective customer packager using identical foundation code, while retaining private original source and tools.
